in 2013, the FBI took down the founder of silk road(the biggest black market the internet had ever seen)

they didn’t need a warrant. they didn’t need a wiretap. they just followed the bitcoin transactions

and honestly? good. that’s how it should work for criminals

but here’s what nobody talks about - the same transparency that caught a drug lord is the same transparency applied to you

every token you’ve moved. every wallet you’ve funded. every position you’ve entered. all of it onchain. all of it visible to anyone who looks

you’re not running a black market. you’re just a regular person who doesn’t think strangers should have a free map of your entire financial life

when you pay cash at a store, the government can still catch criminals. you just don’t have to hand your bank statement to everyone in the room

that’s all privacy really means

and solana never had that option. until now - @BungeeExchange (🎥+🧵)🔻
